summary: "Groovy Situation" is a 1969 song written by Russell Lewis and Herman Davis and first recorded by Mel and Tim. The song became a hit when Gene Chandler recorded it for Mercury Records in 1970, in a version he produced himself.
one_line: A 1969 song by Russell Lewis and Herman Davis, first recorded by Mel and Tim and made a hit by Gene Chandler in 1970.
key_facts: "Groovy Situation" was written by Russell Lewis and Herman Davis.
The song was first recorded by Mel and Tim.
"Groovy Situation" became a hit single when recorded by Gene Chandler.
Gene Chandler recorded "Groovy Situation" on Mercury Records in 1970.
Gene Chandler's version of "Groovy Situation" was produced by Chandler himself.
